2.3.2 Report.AuthoringMetadata
Applies to RDL 2016/01
The Report.AuthoringMetadata element specifies the authoring information about the Report. This
element is optional. If present, this element is of type AuthoringMetadata.
Report.AuthoringMetadata is purely metadata and has no functional implications.
The following is the parent element of the Report.AuthoringMetadata element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.AuthoringMetadata element.
 <xsd:element name="AuthoringMetadata" type="AuthoringMetadataType" minOccurs="0"
xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/reporting/2016/01/reportdefinition/authoringmet
adata" />
